how_to_apply: Download the official notification PDF and Registration Form from the official website.
Fill out the Registration Form with your correct details and attach a passport-size photograph.
Prepare one set of self-attested photocopies of educational qualifications, proof of age, experience certificates, and other relevant documents.
Collect all original certificates and documents for verification during the interview.
Ensure you gather the details of two references including their contact numbers and email IDs for verification of professional experience.
Report directly for the Walk-in-Interview at the designated venue on 13th October 2026 by 9.30 AM for registration.
important_instructions: Candidates must register their names by 9.30 AM at the venue on the day of the interview. Candidates reporting after the scheduled registration time will not be entertained. The engagement is purely on a short-term contractual basis, initially for a period of 89 days, further extendable based on performance evaluation and requirement. Candidates with knowledge of Urdu will be preferred. No TA/DA will be provided to candidates appearing for the Walk-in-Interview. Candidates are advised to satisfy themselves regarding eligibility conditions before appearing for the interview. Canvassing in any form shall render the candidate ineligible automatically. Candidates must produce original documents for verification at the time of the interview. Candidates must provide details of two references including contact numbers and email IDs for professional experience verification.

content_sections.text: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for engagement on a short-term contractual basis for Boys and Girls Hostels at MANUU Off-Campus, Darbhanga (Bihar).

content_sections.text: Age limits for the posts are specified as follows:

rows.qualification_required: (i) M.B.B.S Degree from a recognized University/Institution and must be registered in a State Medical Register or Indian Medical Register.(ii) Three years of proven clinical experience in reputed Hospital.(iii) Knowledge of Urdu (Preferably)

(i) B.Sc. (Nursing) from a recognized University / Institute. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MANUU Medical Officer & Nurse Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the official notification PDF and Registration Form from the official website. Fill out the Registration Form with your correct details and attach a passport-size photograph. Prepare one set of self-attested photocopies of educational qualifications, proof of age, experience certificates, and other relevant documents. Collect all original certificates and documents for verification during the interview. Ensure you gather the details of two references including their contact numbers and email IDs for verification of professional experience. Report directly for the Walk-in-Interview at the designated venue on 13th October 2026 by 9.30 AM for registration.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Original and self-attested photocopies of educational qualification certificates Proof of age Experience certificates Caste certificate (if applicable) Other relevant documents One passport-size photograph

content_sections.heading: MANUU Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates must register their names by 9.30 AM at the venue on the day of the interview. Candidates reporting after the scheduled registration time will not be entertained. The engagement is purely on a short-term contractual basis, initially for a period of 89 days, further extendable based on performance evaluation and requirement. Candidates with knowledge of Urdu will be preferred. No TA/DA will be provided to candidates appearing for the Walk-in-Interview. Candidates are advised to satisfy themselves regarding eligibility conditions before appearing for the interview. Canvassing in any form shall render the candidate ineligible automatically. Candidates must produce original documents for verification at the time of the interview. Candidates must provide details of two references including contact numbers and email IDs for professional experience verification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment organisation for this notification?
faq.answer: Maulana Azad National Urdu University (MANUU) is conducting this recruitment.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for Medical Officer and Nurse posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 13th October 2026 at 10.00 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the reporting time for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must register their names by 9.30 AM at the venue on the day of the interview.

faq.question: Q5. Where is the interview venue?
faq.answer: The venue is MANUU-Provost Office, Ilyas Ashraf Nagar, Chandanpatti, Laheriasarai, Darbhanga, Bihar – 846 002.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for a Medical Officer?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.B.B.S Degree from a recognized University/Institution and be registered in a State Medical Register or Indian Medical Register, along with three years of proven clinical experience in a reputed hospital.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification required for a Nurse?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.Sc. (Nursing) degree or 10+2 with a Diploma in General Nursing & Mid-Wifery (GNM), plus registration as a Nurse with the Indian Nursing Council or State Nursing Council and two years of nursing experience in a reputed hospital.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The monthly consolidated remuneration for the Medical Officer ranges from ₹50,000/- to ₹60,000/- per month, depending upon experience.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q10. What is the period of engagement?
faq.answer: The engagement is purely on a short-term contractual basis for an initial period of 89 days, which may be extended further based on performance and university requirements.
